findings.question: What was the moment when you said, "Wow, this AI thing is really important for us?
findings.answer_text: The moment when I said, "Wow, this AI thing is really important for us," was during a discussion about the potential of deep learning and its impact on software development. This statement was made in the context of learning about deep learning at the same time as others were competing for access to the GeForce GTX 580 GPU in 2012. I was deeply impressed by the effectiveness of deep learning in solving complex problems and its potential to revolutionize software development. This moment marked a pivotal realization for me, highlighting the transformative power of AI in shaping the future of computing and software.
